evidence.reason: qemu_command resolves the supplied run directory and interpolates it directly into the `-drive` `file=` option without escaping or rejecting embedded commas. QEMU treats an embedded comma as an option delimiter and requires it to be doubled, so a run/state path such as `probe,local` produces a malformed drive specification. The supplied implementation has no validation preventing that path, so this is an ordinary correctness defect in the existing command construction.
